mission.title: Turf of Vengeance
mission.description: Hunt down leads on Morpheus' whereabouts.

npc.say: Okay, okay! I'll talk! Morpheus came through here about a week ago looking for someone. I don't know who this person was but Morpheus seems to think that they pose a threat to us all... That is all I know, I swear!
My computer is in my bedroom. Just take the disk and go.

phase.briefing: We are attempting to track Morpheus within the Matrix and we've isolated his previous location down to a few possible candidates. We want you to make your way to each of these locations and interrogate a target. If the target is not cooperative, find a way to make them talk. We are sending you to the first possible location right now. Once you are there you will question a target about Morpheus. If they do not cooperate, feel free to use excessive force; extremely excessive.

enter.say: This is the first location. The target's name is Alpha. You have your orders, {player}. Proceed.

talk.say: I refuse to tell you anything about Morpheus!
I don't expect to get any information out of Fortuna, so this is what I suggest: Kill Fortuna! If you do this, I think it will put the fear into Alpha, and make her talk.
Get the hell out of here!
Your presence makes me want to retch!

Okay, okay! I'll talk! Morpheus came through here about a week ago looking for someone. I don't know who this person was but Morpheus seems to think that they pose a threat to us all... That is all I know, I swear!

done.say: I knew she would come around... You've done well. I will notify Flood of your progress.

talk.say: How dare you show your face around here. I refuse to tell you anything, {player}!

done.say: That wasn't required, but it doesn't bother me as long as the main job gets done.

phase.briefing: The second location is the home of a bluepill named Rhett De Bonte. Go there now.

enter.say: Rhett De Bonte has been contacted a couple times by Morpheus in an attempt to recruit him to Zion's cause. Now, I know you once affiliated yourself with them, but it shouldn't dissuade you in completing your task. Just interrogate Rhett De Bonte and recover any information that he might have on Morpheus.

talk.say: Uhm, excuse me. What are you doing here? Can I help you? Oh, you're here about... Morpheus? I... I don't know what to tell you, but he has been telling me some rather strange things about life. I'm a bit put off by his words and it has gotten me pretty depressed so I may be able to help you out... There is a recording on my computer that this "Morpheus" gave me. If you want it, it's yours. I couldn't understand it anyway.

objective.text: Get the recording from Rhett De Bonte's computer

done.say: I'm going to need you to upload that to me through a hardline.

phase.briefing: The final location is housed by a group of Renegade Exiles who are operating outside of the Merovingian's control. These Exiles have been tracking Morpheus' movement as well and we need you to recover any information that they may have obtained. As with the first location, you may resort to violence if you feel it is necessary to recover the information we seek.

enter.say: Remember, these Exiles aren't working with the Merovingian, and may be irrational in their actions. Try not to get yourself killed.

done.say: It appears that the Exile you just killed was carrying something... Search the body!

objective.text: Get the key from Elite Guard

done.say: As I thought. I think that key unlocks the desk.
I do believe that this is what we are looking for. I'll scan the dossier and send it off to the proper contact once you get them to me through a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the recording at a hardline
Upload the dossier at a hardline

near.say: I think you're getting warmer... Two guards are in the next room standing watch over a locked desk.

mission.finish: That is all...for now. Go about your business, {player}.
